prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic red warrior-goddess fashion portrait with flowing silk, gold accents, and a fan in motion.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with long black hair in a partial warrior updo, dramatic red fully covered high-fashion gown with structured bodice, flowing chiffon panels and black leather obi belt, gold arm cuffs, shoulder accents, crimson matte lips and sharp eyeliner; low powerful stance with one knee forward, folding fan thrust toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 portrait, dark background with red silk ribbons swirling like flames, glowing embers, eyes critically sharp and fan slightly motion-blurred.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm frontal key, fiery red rim light, dramatic sculpting shadows, glow on fabric edges, mythic controlled power.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm cinematic look, f/2.8, ISO 400, 1/160, subtle 35mm grain, realistic fabric and fan, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic 4:5 editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional warrior woman with long black hair in a partial ornamental updo, dramatic red fully covered gown with structured bodice and flowing chiffon panels, black leather obi belt, gold arm cuffs, red silk ribbons swirling like flames, glowing embers, low powerful stance with one knee forward, gold folding fan thrust toward camera, fiery rim light, warm key, 85mm f/2.8, eyes sharp, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, dangerous weapon, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, flat lighting, overexposed reds, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: red warrior goddess reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve red gown, obi belt, fan, silk ribbons, stance, lighting and embers; keep identity and ornament details replaceable.
